In this video, I explore Shenzhen, China’s most futuristic city where driverless taxis, drone deliveries, humanoid robots, and world-changing technology are already part of daily life.
Just a few decades ago, this was a fishing village. Today, it’s one of the most advanced cities on Earth.
Travel Partner: Before this journey, I used ⁠ to compare flight options and plan my trip to China.
